script: [serious] America went to war in Vietnam over an attack that never happened. August fourth, nineteen sixty-four. Two US destroyers in the Gulf of Tonkin reported they were under torpedo attack. Within hours, President Johnson ordered airstrikes. Three days later, Congress handed him the power to wage war. Four hundred sixteen to zero in the House. Eighty-eight to two in the Senate. But the NSA's own historian later went back through the intercepts. His verdict: no attack occurred that night. The intelligence had been skewed to fit. Send this to someone who still trusts the official story. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number twenty-four. A new file every day.
